notes.subject: מקבת בור
notes.rationale: makkevet bor: 'hole of the quarry/pit ol i brukim ston long en' — sampela i tanim olsem 'ples ol i kukim ston', sampela 'hol bilong ples kalanggu'

notes.subject: חצבתם / נקרתם
notes.rationale: tupela tok wankain mining — katim na dikim — ol i.pairim olsem sung bilong stat, lus long tanim tok

notes.subject: שמעו אלי
notes.rationale: ves i opim wantaim singsing bilong kolim: harim, lukluk — imperatif

notes.subject: ol i ran long tsedek
notes.rationale: tok i go stret long ol Isrel i save painim Yahwe

translation: Harimim mi, ol i save ran long tsedek, ol i save painim Yahwe: lukluk long roks ol i katim yupela long en, na long hol bilong ples kalanggu ol i dikim yupela long en.

tokens.gloss: ol i save ran olgeta long
ol i katim yupela long en
ol i dikim yupela long en
